successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Khasso on both banks of the upper Senegal from Kayes to Bafoulabé, 'a strip at most 60 km wide' (the river widened by 30 km, cut to the stretch between the two towns)

wars.name: Umar Tall in Khasso
wars.outcome: November 1854: Umar Tall "completed a lightning conquest of Bambuk" and the petty kings of Khasso submitted; in 1857 he attacked Khasso but was repulsed at Medina Fort (the page does not describe a separate 1855 siege).

wars.name: French fort at Médine
wars.outcome: September 1855: Governor Faidherbe built a fort at Médine and extended French protection over the "Khasso Confederation"; the page describes no formal treaty by name.

certainty.note: A strip of at most 60 km; the 1800 split into five states is not outlined on the page.
